symptom: Rewriting a document **deletes every language but one**: a `describe page` → `exec` round-trip drops a page's Dutch title from the entire project, and `show languages` counts fall. `mx check` reports 0 errors before and after
cause: A Mendix text is a `Texts$Text` holding one `Texts$Translation` child per language, and MDL carries **one string** — `Title: 'My Account'` — so a rebuilt document has exactly one child and the rest are gone. The legacy reader compounds it: `extractTextFromBson` returns the first non-empty text and ignores `LanguageCode` entirely
insight: Carry the stored translations onto the rebuild, in the same chain as the other things a rebuild would lose (identity, element `$ID`s, `PersistentId`) — so **both engines get it from one place** (`sdk/mpr/writer_units.go` and `modelsdk/mpr/writer_core.go` both call `canon.Reconcile`). Pair texts **by containment path when the two documents hold texts at exactly the same paths** (exact, and the only way to carry a text whose source the statement CHANGED), else **by source string**. A mis-pair here is NOT benign the way `TransplantIDs`' is — that rewrites every reference with the id, whereas copying a translation onto the wrong text injects a translation of a different string — so positional pairing is abandoned entirely if one path differs rather than applied where it fits. **Append the stored `Texts$Translation` sub-document verbatim**, not a freshly built one: without its `$ID` the canonical form differs and no-op elision can never fire. Ambiguous source (two stored texts share a source, disagree on the translation) → carry nothing. **`mx check` is not the oracle** — a model missing a translation is valid; count `Texts$Translation` elements or use `show languages`. Controls: remove the call from `Reconcile` → nl_NL 335 → 328 on one page, and `TestReconcile_TranslatedDocumentRoundTripsUnchanged` fails. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/translations-preserved-on-rewrite.mdl`. PROPOSAL_translations.md slice 1
